OWNER DECISIONS 2026-09-30 (in chat) on contract v2 (sha256 033700bb556c8bc9...):
- D1: Gale DMat/DVec are the only representation; hrf.linalg.Mat/Vec deleted, no alias; staged S0-S5.
- D5: pin-gated breaking changes with a migration inventory and replacement examples; S5 waits until eidolon and PLSNeuro are past S3; no deprecation bridges.
- D2: request an enforceable builder-owned transfer from Gale only if S4 misses the 5% non-inferiority margin; never a caller-supplied array.
- D3: JS timing is evidence, not a gate.
- D4: cbind moves upstream as DMat.hcat.
Implementation still requires per-slice ownership and review; this decision does not authorize an upstream Gale publication.
